overviewParagraphs: Set against the stunning backdrop of the East Sea, Sea Links Golf Club is a masterpiece of golf course architecture. Designed by Ronald Fream, the course stretches over 7,600 yards and is renowned for its sheer difficulty, characterized by steep elevation changes, deep bunkers, and fast, undulating greens. The coastal winds add another layer of complexity, demanding precision and strategic thinking from every tee. Despite its challenging nature, the spectacular views and world-class conditions make it an unforgettable experience. The resort also features a 5-star hotel, luxury villas, and a massive clubhouse with panoramic views, making it a complete destination for golf travelers.

curatorBriefHtml: Sea Links Golf & Country Club (opened 2008 by Ronald Fream in Mui Ne / Phan Thiet) is one of Southern Vietnam’s toughest coastal tests — carved across towering red-sand dunes overlooking the East Sea. Stretching up to 7,617 yards from the championship tips (Par 72), Sea Links combines steep rolling elevation changes, dense rough, deep greenside bunkers, and persistent Mui Ne sea winds that turn par into a genuine achievement.

Because almost every hole sits elevated above Mui Ne Bay with sweeping coastal vistas, club selection into shifting crosswinds defines the round. Playing forward from the White or Blue tees rather than biting off the full 7,617-yard championship card is the key to keeping the round enjoyable for visiting holiday groups.

Now just 2.5 hours from Ho Chi Minh City via the Dau Giay–Phan Thiet Expressway — and only 20 minutes from PGA Ocean Course (NovaWorld) — Sea Links pairs naturally into a sunny Mui Ne / Phan Thiet beach-and-golf break.

scorecard.verdict: Recognized as one of the most challenging links layouts in Asia. Set 80 meters above Mui Ne Bay, fierce crosswinds and steep dune contours test every shot in your bag.

faqs.q: How difficult is Sea Links Golf Club in Mui Ne?
faqs.a: Sea Links is legitimately one of Southern Vietnam’s toughest tests due to undulating dunes, tight greenside bunkering, and steady Mui Ne ocean winds. Moving forward a tee box (rather than playing the 7,617-yard tips) keeps the round fun and strategic.

faqs.q: How far is Sea Links from PGA Ocean Course and Ho Chi Minh City?
faqs.a: Sea Links is just 20 minutes from PGA Ocean Course at NovaWorld Phan Thiet, and roughly 2.5 to 3 hours east of Ho Chi Minh City via the modern expressway.

faqs.q: When is the best season to golf in Mui Ne / Phan Thiet?
faqs.a: Mui Ne enjoys a dry, sunny coastal micro-climate almost year-round, with November through May offering the clearest skies and brisk, invigorating sea breezes.

faqs.q: Are beachfront resorts close to Sea Links Golf Club?
faqs.a: Yes — Sea Links sits right above Mui Ne’s main beachfront resort strip, putting boutique coastal hotels and fresh seafood dining within 5 to 15 minutes of the clubhouse.
